title: Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation: Masterpieces
subtitle: Twenty paintings in which marks and shapes remain visible inside the things they describe.
introduction:
Van Gogh's coffee pot is emphatically blue, Cézanne's countryside is assembled through patches, and Monet's cathedral begins to lose the solidity expected of stone. These works do not abandon recognisable subjects. They make it difficult to forget that a subject has been constructed in paint.

The Goulandris selection also includes pictures in which recognition becomes less secure. A few lines sustain a head; a title proposes an insect; an architectural fragment finds itself beside rearing horses. Rather than asking which works are “realistic,” follow the different amounts of information needed to identify something. A plain glass and an imaginary body can both reveal how much pictorial conviction depends on the relation between a shape and its surroundings.
visitNote: This guide concerns the Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation’s Athens collection, not its museum on Andros. Display arrangements and loans can change. The Athens museum also offers its own collection information and audio guides; consult the foundation’s visitor page for current access.

books.title: Concerning the Spiritual in Art
books.author: Wassily Kandinsky; translated by Michael Sadleir
books.note: Kandinsky argues that colour and form can act without copying visible objects. His text offers a direct companion to Both Striped and a point of comparison with Klee, Léger and the more material surfaces of Fautrier.

works.title: Olive Picking
works.credit: Vincent van Gogh (1853 - 1890); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The workers' movements belong to a grove already active with short strokes and twisting trunks. Van Gogh does not separate human labour from a quietly neutral landscape. Trees, soil and figures share a restless handling, while differences of shape keep the workers identifiable. The picture's movement comes from both the represented task and the marks connecting its setting.

works.title: Still Life with a Coffee Pot
works.credit: Vincent van Gogh (1853 - 1890); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The blue pot stands firmly against yellow, but the smaller objects introduce a changing set of patterns and contours around it. Van Gogh uses ordinary vessels as partners in a colour arrangement. Their familiarity makes the departures easy to follow: a cup remains a cup while its outline and shadow become forceful elements in the surface.

works.title: Both Striped
works.credit: Wassily Kandinsky (1866 - 1944); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The two large forms seem related before they can be identified as anything. Repeated bands connect them, while differences of direction and scale prevent them from becoming twins. Kandinsky gives them a field of smaller arcs and rectangles in which to act. Interaction can be suggested through position without supplying characters or an illustrated event.

works.title: Dynamics of a Head
works.credit: Paul Klee (1879 - 1940); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The pale circles provide a foothold for reading eyes within overlapping colour. Once a face emerges, its surrounding bands remain visibly independent shapes. Klee keeps both accounts available. The image is more structured than an arbitrary collection of patches, yet less settled than a conventional likeness; its activity lies in moving between those readings.

works.title: Rouen Cathedral in the Morning: Pink Dominant
works.catalogueTitle: La cathédrale de Rouen le matin (dominante rose)
works.credit: Claude Monet (1840 - 1926); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Dark openings preserve the façade's divisions within pink and violet marks. Stone has not vanished, but its painted appearance depends on conditions that stone itself does not control. Monet makes architecture and illumination difficult to separate. The building supplies a repeated structure through which slight changes of colour can become the main incident.

works.title: The Grasshopper
works.credit: Joan Miró (1893 - 1983); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The title offers a creature before the sparse signs supply a straightforward body. Thin lines and small coloured forms spread across yellow, interrupted by a dark lower shape. Miró leaves recognition partial. Treating every mark as an insect part would make the picture less open than its actual arrangement, in which signs can suggest life without illustrating anatomy.

works.title: Archaic Landscape
works.credit: Theodoros Stamos (1922 - 1997); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Fragments and pool-like shapes suggest terrain without fixing a scale. Stamos's textured brown field can seem close and material, while its scattered forms invite a broader landscape reading. The blue area near the bottom introduces another kind of surface. The painting can evoke accumulated matter without becoming a map of an identifiable place.

works.title: Balcony with Horizontal Pilasters
works.credit: Nikos Hadjikyriakos-Ghika (1906 - 1994); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The balcony supplies an architectural starting point for bands, grids and curved forms that no longer obey one viewpoint. Hadjikyriakos-Ghika gives small decorative details a place inside larger divisions. The structure is read through repetition and interlocking surfaces. Architecture becomes available for rearrangement rather than serving only as something faithfully viewed from outside.

works.title: Caryatid
works.medium: Pencil and gouache on paper laid down on canvas
works.credit: Amedeo Modigliani (1884 - 1920); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Raised arms make the kneeling figure resemble a support even though no building rests above her. Modigliani simplifies joints into broad curves, giving the body a compact relation of bearing and balance. The architectural title changes how the pose is read. A human form can imply a load through its organisation before the load is actually shown.

works.title: Countryside in Auvers-sur-Oise
works.credit: Paul Cézanne (1839 - 1906); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The road and slopes establish distance, while repeated green and ochre strokes keep their construction visible. Cézanne's tall trees frame a landscape whose solidity comes from adjoining patches rather than smooth continuous shading. The eye can follow a route towards the houses and also stop at the local relations of colour that make that route possible.

works.title: Getting Out of the Bath
works.credit: Pierre Bonnard (1867 - 1947); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Patterned tiles, fixtures and fabrics compete with the bending figure. Bonnard makes a recognisable private action harder to isolate because so much of the room remains active in colour. The body must be found among those surfaces. Its partial entanglement with the setting distinguishes this picture from a figure simply placed against a decorative background.

works.title: Glass with Water
works.medium: Mixed media on paper laid down on canvas
works.credit: Jean Fautrier (1898 - 1964); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The glass is identifiable, but the rough painted field refuses to imitate its expected smoothness. Thin ridges and thicker matter maintain an outline without producing an illusion of pure transparency. Fautrier places two material facts in tension: the vessel the image represents and the worked surface through which it becomes visible.

works.title: Harmony
works.credit: Constantinos Parthenis (1878 - 1967); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Long bodies are lightly distinguished from the pale field around them. Parthenis reduces the sense of flesh and a definite location, allowing curved outlines to carry relations between the figures. The allegorical title does not correspond to a single easily named action. The image's coherence has to be followed through these restrained connections.

works.title: Head of a Hostage No. 17
works.medium: Mixed media on paper laid down on canvas
works.credit: Jean Fautrier (1898 - 1964); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: A pale oval and a few marked features barely sustain a face against the rough ground. The word “hostage” prevents that reduction from remaining a purely formal exercise. Fautrier brings a human subject close to the limit of recognition, using damaged-looking matter rather than a descriptive scene of violence. The title and surface must be considered together.

works.title: Horses on the Beach
works.credit: Giorgio de Chirico (1888 - 1978); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © SIAE 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The rearing horses supply movement within an otherwise strangely settled combination of beach and architectural fragments. De Chirico keeps the individual things legible while withholding an ordinary explanation of their coexistence. Recognition does not resolve the scene. Knowing what a horse or a fragment is leaves open why they share this precisely presented place.

works.title: Italian Town
works.medium: Gouache on board laid down on canvas
works.credit: André Derain (1880 - 1954); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The broad square has little activity to distract from the intervals between its buildings. Sharply bounded façades and small clouds preserve the clarity of the arrangement beneath the large sky. Derain gives urban space a subject without a dominant event. Its near-emptiness makes proportion and separation unusually consequential.

works.title: Man in an Interior
works.credit: Victor Brauner (1903 - 1966); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: The chair, floor and shadow behave more ordinarily than the upright figure beside them. Brauner uses that familiar evidence of a room to make an impossible combination of bodily and object-like parts appear to occupy space. The contradiction is sharpened by its setting. A less plausible environment would give the figure less resistance against which to seem strange.

works.title: Mechanical Element
works.credit: Fernand Léger (1881 - 1955); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Tubes, discs and bands suggest machinery without explaining a mechanism. Léger extracts relations of curve, overlap and contrast from components associated with practical use. Their organisation is clear even though no operating sequence can be reconstructed. The picture asks what machine forms can do visually once they are released from the obligation to work together mechanically.

works.title: Ninety-nine Heads
works.medium: Oil on hard fibre board primed with chalk, zinc white and fish glue, with photo affixed and lilac watercolour
works.credit: Friedensreich Hundertwasser (1928 - 2000); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © 2023 NAMIDA AG, Glarus, Switzerland, All Rights Reserved; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Faces accumulate across the red field, often within smaller coloured compartments. Differences of size interrupt the repeated format, with larger eyes disrupting any regular count. Hundertwasser gives each head enough information to remain readable while allowing the group to spread as a pattern. Repetition creates company here without producing uniform scale or orderly ranks.

works.title: Nude
works.medium: Oil on canvas laid down on cradled panel
works.credit: André Derain (1880 - 1954); Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation
works.license: Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; © ADAGP, Paris / OSDEETE, Athens 2023; Copyright © 2026 Basil & Elise Goulandris Foundation; Terms of Use & Privacy Policy Financial information
works.description: Pale areas distinguish the torso within dark foliage and rough curved marks. Derain lets the body's handling share something with the surrounding vegetation, but the extended arm and seated pose preserve a separate figure. The image does not require a clear studio boundary to give the body weight. Its distinction from the landscape remains partial and worked for.

closingSections.title: Keep two readings available
paragraphs: Choose a recognisable object and follow the marks that make it. Then look at a more abstract work without immediately demanding names for all its forms. These are comparisons within the collection; consult the Foundation's current display information for a visit.
